principle: for every irreversible lifecycle operation: journal intent BEFORE the side effect, journal result AFTER, checkpoint at safe boundaries, and allow the successor ONLY after the durable result is published. Writer replay hazards are never created by mechanical application — the writer boundary fails closed instead.

writerHazardRule: NO mechanical checkpoint pattern is applied to a writer mid-mutation: a crash after mutation but before a durable result NEVER auto-resumes the writer. The resume classifies the interrupted writer（RESTORABLE / RECONSTRUCTABLE / ALREADY_APPLIED / CONFLICTED / INVALID）and only ALREADY_APPLIED recovers the result — never re-mutates. Ambiguous state fails closed（RECOVERY_REQUIRED）.
sideEffectIdentity: writerSideEffectId = sha256(executionId:phaseId:generation)[0:24] — deterministic per attempt; the side-effect commit marker is persisted before any successor runs（Stage 8 effectively-once within the governed writer contract）.
